_howto: Elections polled by the Hawaii Office of Elections adapter (server/src/adapters/hioe.js). folder = the results folder under {base} (as linked from https://elections.hawaii.gov/election-results/); the adapter reads {folder}/summary.txt (tab-separated, #FormatVersion 1). A 404 or the placeholder text means 'not released yet' and writes nothing. Statewide only (no county column). Set enabled:false to stop polling.
